newsitem.title: UK: Bulgarian playwright wins British award.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian playwright wins British award.

text.p: Bulgarian Hristo Boytchev was on Thursday named the first winner of the British Council's annual International New Playwriting Award.
Boytchev's "The Colonel Bird" was selected from more than 400 scripts received from all over the world, British playwright Harold Pinter said in a statement.

The panel of judges said the play was a parable for our times and described it as "joyful, magical idiosyncratic, with an inspired comic premise". Boytchev will receive a prize of 3,000 pounds ($4,800) and his play may be produced in Britain.
